post_generation_candidate_audit.mathematical_verdict: Correct under fixed finite support, affine-in-q mixture probabilities, complete RU line sets, and outer max_q regret: g=min_{i,t} line_{i,t} is concave; more generally, a finite pointwise minimum of concave functions on a common convex domain is concave. On each action-i own-envelope interval, E_i-g is convex, so endpoints suffice.
post_generation_candidate_audit.complexity_verdict: With K total RU lines, one lower hull plus O(K) own knots and O(log K) queries gives O(K log K) time and O(K) storage after line/knot construction; compare against all-union-knots RU and tiny all-intersection exact checks.
post_generation_candidate_audit.exact_falsifier: At alpha=.05, A has deterministic losses 0/state0 and 10/state1, B is deterministic loss 1: E_A=min(10,200q), E_B=1, g=min(E_A,1), competitor kink q=.005, A own knots {0,.05,1}, and max A-regret 9 at own knots.
scope_caveats: Include every own lower-envelope breakpoint; cumulative crossings suffice only for fixed finite supports.
Tie-safe owner sets are needed for duplicate supports, parallel lines, and coincident breakpoints.
Fixed per-action switching costs shift line intercepts; previous-action-dependent costs require context-indexed hulls.
Outer max over finite worlds commutes with per-world max_q; min_q max_world and expectation objectives do not permit the same shortcut.
post_generation_candidate_audit.novelty_status: USEFUL EXACT COMPUTATIONAL COMPOSITION / HIGH PRIOR-ART OVERLAP / LIKELY CONVEX-ANALYSIS COROLLARY / NO STANDALONE NOVELTY CLAIM
post_generation_candidate_audit.minimum_experiment: Exact fixtures plus matched all-union-knots RU comparator: verify identical values, regrets, winners, owner witnesses, and measured runtime/memory on increasing finite banks.

correction_after_review.correction: The earlier audit wording that generic pointwise min-concavity was false was incorrect. Hypograph intersection proves finite min-concavity on a common convex domain.
